phenotype_id: # Pre-computed continuous cognitive / EA-proxy scores from the ea_proxy workflow.
# These are GWASed as external quantitative traits: IRNT -> residualize on
# sex_c + PC1..PC10 (they are already age/sex-normalized upstream; this matches
# the repo's final g-EA proxy GWAS covariates). Run the ea_proxy scoring steps
# first, then VERIFY each score_file path and value_col below on the platform;
# missing files (or a wrong column -> 0 samples) are skipped with a warning.
# PAN_AOU_COG_DIR defaults to the ETM/proxy score output dir (set it if different).
# --- ETM cognitive task scores (recommended per-task summary, age/sex-normalized) ---

description: Delay Discounting: patience = negative log mean discount rate k (official -lnk); higher = more patient / less delay discounting
GradCPT sustained attention: PC1 of d-prime, -log(RT CV), -log(median RT); higher = better sustained attention
Flanker inhibitory control: official AoU Flanker rate-correct score (0-100); higher = better attentional control/efficiency
Emotional Recognition: PC1 of accuracy score, -log(RT CV), -log(median RT); higher = better emotion recognition
EA teacher label: educational-attainment years residualized on year-of-birth, sex, and their interaction, then z-scored
SES-EA proxy: cross-fit XGBoost survey/area-SES -> EA-years proxy (no genotypes), z-scored
Fine-tuned proxy: SES-EA boosters continued-trained toward the GradCPT+Flanker mean, z-scored
Direct scratch-XGBoost survey -> GradCPT+Flanker proxy (trained from scratch, not fine-tuned), z-scored
G4 fine-tuned proxy: SES-EA boosters continued-trained toward the 4-domain ETM-g factor, z-scored
Final selected g-EA proxy: no-teacher calibration of the SES-EA + fine-tuned + direct proxies (the headline phenotype)
